'''Reubens Robotic Systems''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company who, along with [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], designed the [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] to bridge the gap between [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reubens Robotic Systems was a [[fanon]] invention with the name being a reference to the name of [[RX-24/Legends|RX-24's]] voice actor, [[Paul Reubens]]. It became [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity when it was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|117|RX-24 (Rex)}}</ref> a three-volume reference book edited by [[Bob Vitas]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and released on [[December 9]], [[2008]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref>
